beats.ul-0-001: You stand at the grease-stained Returns Desk as brass clocks chime midnight, sorting damp volumes while the night-porter warms his fingers over a smoky tallow lamp.
beats.ul-0-017: A damp, folded parchment left upon your sorting trolley reveals Thessaly Marr's urgent handwriting warning that the Hundredth Door has swung open.
beats.ul-0-038: You step past the squeaking wicker gate into the shifting labyrinth of the stack-ways, holding your flickering lamp high as the Long Closing countdown begins.

ul-0-002.situation: Shelvers sort mounds of newly returned texts under flickering tallow lamps while searching for any clue regarding the missing Archivist.

ul-0-018.situation: Overcrowded book-trolleys rattle past towering rows of moving pine shelves while rival junior pages whisper of the opening vault.

chains.ul-0-002/0: You inspect the damp invoice pile using sharp scholarly observation, risking a paper cut from a poisoned page to unearth the secret docket.
chains.ul-0-002/1: You decipher the smudged marginalia on the ledger's edge through careful academic focus, risking an ink-stain hex to discover a hidden corridor key.
chains.ul-0-002/2: You translate the night-porter's cryptic mumbling by studying past roster sheets, risking a bout of exhaustion to secure his old brass sorting stamp.
chains.ul-0-018/0: You study the complex Dewey decimal shift patterns to predict the next aisle collision, risking a crushing bookshelf to find a dry leather pouch.
chains.ul-0-018/1: You trick the suspicious lending clerk with a clever falsehood about missing fines, risking a public reprimand to pocket a bundle of linen twine.
chains.ul-0-018/2: You flatter the grumpy cataloguer into turning a blind eye to your wandering, risking a formal demerit to gain a pinch of protective alum powder.
chains.ul-0-018/3: You research the ancient floor-weight equations in the dusty blue folios, risking a collapsed stack to retrieve an ivory bone-handled bookmark.
